title: Georgia Officer Saves Choking Baby
description:
** (Disclaimer: This video content is intended for educational and informational purposes only) **
Marietta, Ga., police officer Nick St. Onge was captured on dash camera video saving a 2-month-old infant after she stopped breathing while drinking a bottle of milk. He said he was at the right place at the right time.
